info.title: Riverside Library: javascript: URIs in markdown links

tags.name: Catalogue
tags.description:
A catalogue record.

See [the cataloguing guide](javascript:window.__fixtureUriFired=true) for shelf mark rules.

Also written as [a reference-style link][guide], and as an autolink: <javascript:window.__fixtureUriFired=true>.

And with a scheme obfuscated by case and whitespace: [mixed](JaVaScRiPt:alert(1)).

[guide]: javascript:window.__fixtureUriFired=true
